# `/campaigns` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /campaigns/v1

`getActiveCampaignsV1` — List campaigns

Use this API to get a list of campaigns. This API can provide increased level of detail for each campaign for the correct provided query.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-report:manage, idn:campaign-report:read, idn:campaign:manage, idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `detail` (query) — one of SLIM, FULL — Determines whether slim, or increased level of detail is provided for each campaign in the returned list. Slim is the default behavior.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, sw; status: eq, in — e.g. `name eq "Manager Campaign"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, created — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: array of object

### POST /campaigns/v1

`createCampaignV1` — Create a campaign

Use this API to create a certification campaign with the information provided in the request body. When the request body references a campaign filter (`filter.type: CAMPAIGN_FILTER`), the token must include both `idn:campaign:manage` and `idn:campaign-filter:read`.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-filter:read, idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): campaign-2
- Returns 202: campaign-2

### GET /campaigns/v1/{id}

`getCampaignV1` — Get campaign

Use this API to get information for an existing certification campaign by the campaign's ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage, idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign to be retrieved.
  - `detail` (query) — one of SLIM, FULL — Determines whether slim, or increased level of detail is provided for each campaign in the returned list. Slim is the default behavior.
- Returns 200: object

### PATCH /campaigns/v1/{id}

`updateCampaignV1` — Update a campaign

Use this API to update individual fields on a certification campaign, using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage, idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign template being modified.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: slimcampaign

### POST /campaigns/v1/{id}/reassign

`moveV1` — Reassign certifications

This API reassigns the specified certifications from one identity to another.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The certification campaign ID
- Body (application/json): adminreviewreassign
- Returns 202: certificationtask

### POST /campaigns/v1/{id}/activate

`startCampaignV1` — Activate a campaign

Use this API to submit a job to activate the certified campaign with the specified ID. The campaign must be staged. :::note A STAGED campaign can be activated only when its `deadline` is in the future. Activating with a deadline of today or in the past returns a 400 error. List and get campaign APIs still report `STAGED` after the deadline; set a future deadline with `PATCH /campaigns/v1/{id}` before activating. :::

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Campaign ID.
- Body (application/json): activatecampaignoptions
- Returns 202: object

### POST /campaigns/v1/{id}/complete

`completeCampaignV1` — Complete a campaign

:::caution This endpoint will run successfully for any campaigns that are **past due**. This endpoint will return a content error if the campaign is **not past due**. ::: Use this API to complete a certification campaign. This functionality is provided to admins so that they can complete a certification even if all items have not been completed.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Campaign ID.
- Body (application/json): campaigncompleteoptions
- Returns 202: object

### POST /campaigns/v1/delete

`deleteCampaignsV1` — Delete campaigns

Use this API to delete certification campaigns whose IDs are specified in the provided list of campaign IDs.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): campaignsdeleterequest
- Returns 202: object

### POST /campaigns/v1/{id}/run-remediation-scan

`startCampaignRemediationScanV1` — Run campaign remediation scan

Use this API to run a remediation scan task for a certification campaign.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-report:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign the remediation scan is being run for.
- Returns 202: object

### GET /campaigns/v1/{id}/reports

`getCampaignReportsV1` — Get campaign reports

Use this API to fetch all reports for a certification campaign by campaign ID.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-report:manage, idn:campaign-report:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign whose reports are being fetched.
- Returns 200: array of campaignreport

### POST /campaigns/v1/{id}/run-report/{type}

`startCampaignReportV1` — Run campaign report

Use this API to run a report for a certification campaign.

- Scopes: idn:campaign-report:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the campaign the report is being run for.
  - `type` (path, required) — one of CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION_REPORT, CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS_REPORT, CAMPAIGN_STATUS_REPORT, CERTIFICATION_SIGNOFF_REPORT — Type of the report to run.
- Returns 202: object

### GET /campaigns/v1/reports-configuration

`getCampaignReportsConfigV1` — Get campaign reports configuration

Use this API to fetch the configuration for certification campaign reports. The configuration includes only one element - identity attributes defined as custom report columns.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage, idn:campaign:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Returns 200: campaignreportsconfig

### PUT /campaigns/v1/reports-configuration

`setCampaignReportsConfigV1` — Set campaign reports configuration

Use this API to overwrite the configuration for campaign reports.

- Scopes: idn:campaign:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): campaignreportsconfig
- Returns 200: campaignreportsconfig
